children: Real Matters said Thursday that its chief financial officer, Rodrigo Pinto, will step down from the role to pursue a new career opportunity.
Pinto's resignation from the Canadian network management services provider will be effective Nov. 30, and the company has already begun a search for a successor.
Real Matters noted that Pinto is pursuing an new career opportunity outside of the mortgage industry.
